description: Use FIRST whenever a French company is mentioned by NAME without an identifier. French company search and company lookup by name or SIREN in the official French company registry (INSEE Sirene / INPI RNE data). Returns the top 10 matches, each with a score_confiance (0-1 match confidence) and a correspondance_nom, which together help pick among homonyms; total_results counts every match (tronque: true beyond the 10 served, note_troncature when it is a lower bound). Order: match level first, served as correspondance_nom (exacte: the name, the official name in the French search, equals q once the legal forms written for the result's country are removed at either end of both, never the last word, for the countries of the closed list of written legal forms, a GLEIF result from any other country keeping its whole name; mots_entiers: every remaining word of q is a word of the name; ressemblance: the rest, an acronym or other-field hit included; null if q is a SIREN, SIRET or the result's national ID, or no name is served), then an internal ranking score, not score_confiance (European search: score_confiance before its cap at 1 and its rounding; French search: the similarity of the name, usual name and acronym, plus 0.05 for an active company, the name and acronym only in the real-time fallback); ties: by SIREN in the French search, one country in turn in the European search (rank by national ID within each country, then country code). etages_abandonnes is always present: an empty array means the top 10 is complete; a non-empty one (with resultats_partiels: true) means the local index was degraded and the real-time fallback failed, so the list is partial: retry in a few seconds. If aucune_correspondance_fiable is true, no result resembles the name you asked for (best confidence < 0.5): do NOT treat the top hit as the company; check the spelling or retry. In the local index, typo tolerance only covers active companies under full disclosure: a ceased company, or one under partial disclosure, is found there by its exact name, its beginning or all its words. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): a name search leaves out a unit not proven to be a legal person, uncounted (total_results lowered); a SIREN or SIRET search serves it with denomination null, counted in ecartes.diffusion_partielle. Paid via x402 ($0.002 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

q.description: Company name, or a French identifier (SIREN, SIRET, VAT number); spaced or labelled ("SIREN : 552 032 534") is fine, it resolves directly. Unsupported characters are stripped, not rejected.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
